Medium to Coarse grained, phaneritic, weak to moderately sericite+chlorite altered (plus biotite?, it is ambiguous), weak to moderate magnetic gabbro. The texture: the rock mostly composed of mafic minerals Hb, Bt (60-70%), Plagioclase (30-40%) and trace pyrites. Mafic minerals create coarse patchy, crowded texture of irregular shaped chlorite altered dark green colored Hb and platy brownish Bt crystals. Plagioclases are green sericite altered, smaller in size. Locally plagioclase crysalt preserved its prysmatic crystal shape. Mostly plagioclase crystal structure destroyed becoming anhedral to subhedral. The difference in this gabbro package from the gabbro intersected in drillhole OVD012 is the presentage of the mafic minerals. Here, it contains little greater mafic minerals than OVD012's unmineralized gabbro. At the bottom part of the gabbro, there is 3m interval with Py, Po and Cpy mineralization. There were no visual contact between mineralized part and unmineralized part.
